audioBenchmark.scope: Same real Three.js/Web Audio scene, fixed 24Hz synthetic observations and 60Hz logical render clock paced by setTimeout. 60 warmup + 120 measured logical frames per case (actual wall-clock frame intervals are reported; browser timers may throttle). No MediaPipe inference, physical camera, tablet FPS or physical latency claim. Audio volume 3%; contexts suspended during off controls. Order off / Phase1.7 / Phase1.8 / off; sequential noise can affect frame intervals.
